trials.claim: Lifetime access to kiwilaunch on 1 Code tier
trials.claimQuote:
### 1 Code: $39 (was $936)
- Lifetime access to kiwilaunch
- You must redeem your code(s) within 60 days of purchase
trials.reasoning: The binding terms let the vendor suspend or terminate any account without reason and permanently delete a suspended account and its data after 6 months, materially limiting the promised lifetime access.

exhibits.quote: We reserve the right to reject your request to access and use Platform Services and to suspend or terminate your existing account without having to provide any reason.
exhibits.argument: Lifetime access is undermined because the vendor reserves the right to suspend or terminate any account without reason.

exhibits.quote: If your account stays suspended for more than 6 months, we may permanently delete your account, System Users, and data.
exhibits.argument: Lifetime access is limited because a suspended account can be permanently deleted with data after 6 months.

trials.claimQuote:
Customizable landing page
- Integrated payments
- Own brand experience
- Custom domain
- 1% transaction fee
trials.reasoning: Although the vendor page states a 1% fee, a lifetime-deal buyer reports being charged a 10% commission on top of the deal, directly conflicting with the 1% claim for deal buyers.

exhibits.argument: The 1% claim is misleading because gateway fees are excluded and charged extra on top.

exhibits.quote: On top of that, they still charge a 10% commission on top of the LTD, which makes absolutely no sense.
exhibits.argument: A buyer reports being charged 10% commission on top of the lifetime deal, contradicting the 1% fee claim.
The vendor page states the transaction fee is 1% excluding gateway fees.

trials.claim: Take online bookings and payments and run business from iPhone
trials.claimQuote: Take online bookings and payments, run your business from your iphone
trials.reasoning: The vendor states you can set up services, share a booking link, and let customers book and pay, managed from your iPhone or browser; a generic warranty disclaimer and one server-down report do not materially undercut that.

exhibits.quote: We disclaim any warranty for the continuity of our platform Services and We do not guarantee that our Platform Services will be free of errors or security risks.
exhibits.argument: Running a business from the iPhone app is undermined because continuity and error-free service are expressly disclaimed.

exhibits.quote: I was easily able to apply it on the kiwi launch website but unfortunately the server was down and it was very bad experience
exhibits.argument: A buyer reports the server was down after purchase, preventing bookings and use of the service.

exhibits.quote: Set up your services, share your booking link, and let customers book and pay themselves. All from your iPhone, or your laptop browser.
exhibits.argument: The vendor states customers can book and pay with management from iPhone or browser.

exhibits.quote: Take bookings and get paid online, with no monthly bill. - 100 bookings - Own branding experience - Custom labels and localization
exhibits.argument: The base plan description lists other features but omits custom domain, showing it is tier-gated.
